summary: Improve maintenance planning, CMMS work-order control, and facilities reporting. Explore this practical five-day facility management course.
lede: Asset and facilities management training helps facilities managers, maintenance supervisors, and workplace operations professionals coordinate building services and physical assets. You’ll practise checking asset-register data, ranking maintenance priorities, controlling CMMS work orders, and monitoring service levels, energy use, and occupancy. The course also covers supplier scorecards and performance dashboards to support practical facilities decisions and improvement planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate buildings, facilities services, physical assets, and workplace operations. It suits intermediate practitioners who contribute to facilities decisions and need stronger methods for maintenance control, supplier oversight, or performance reporting.
prerequisites: Prior experience in facilities, building operations, maintenance, workplace services, or a related function is recommended. Familiarity with basic asset records and maintenance requests will help you apply the exercises. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for the work-order and KPI exercises.
